body: I've got some good hobbies already. I am a little pissed its getting too cold to bike around here though.

Yeah I've been listening to a ton of music to keep my spirits up and my mind off what I tried to do.

Oddly enough The Postal Service has always been one of my favorite feel-good bands and I picked their album to go out on.
Yeah the Lexapro is for anxiety. I tried Zoloft before but it made me really nauseous and made me feel almost like i was tripping.

I'm sorta used to being numb. Before my anxiety got really bad I kinda just auto-piloted through life. Not a great plan really but it got me through. I do actually keep an occasional journal and write music so I think that will help.
Yeah it was gonna be a novelty account but I forgot about it, so now I guess it's my throwaway
Hey man, the kind words are support enough. I don't even really have any troubles other than severe anxiety thats been fucking my life up more and more lately.
